National Hazing Prevention Week 2026 🐊
 
From Monday 9/21-Friday 9/25, join us as we recognize National Hazing Prevention Week to learn how you can take a stand against hazing. Events are all free to attend for UF students, faculty, and staff. 

🖼️Monday 9/21-Friday 9/25 9am-5pm: Hazing Prevention Museum | Student Engagement Portal, Reitz Level 2 | Interactive museum with activities & resources
☕️Monday 9/21 9am-11am: Mocha Monday | Student Engagement Portal, Reitz Level 2 | Free coffee while supplies last  
🕵️‍♂️Monday 9/21 4pm, 5pm, 6pm: The Choice - Escape Room | Reitz Union Room 2340 | Interactive escape room challenges
🍽️Tuesday 9/22 12pm-1:30pm: Lunch & Learn | Reitz Union Ground Level - Workshops available for students, faculty/staff, and student org advisors
📝Wednesday 9/23 2pm & 3pm: Know the Code Bingo | Reitz Union Level 3, Rion Ballroom | Hazing prevention-themed bingo
🪩Wednesday 9/23 6pm-8pm: Bracelet Making with GatorNights | Reitz Union G310 & G315 | Bracelet making and reflection activities
🤝Thursday 9/24 11am-1pm: Tabling Fair | Reitz Union North Lawn/Terrace | Hazing prevention resources and activities with campus partners 
☕️Friday 9/25 9am-11am: Coffee w/ a Cop | Plaza of the Americas - Free coffee while supplies last
